requirement: The public brand door answers 503 JSON LANE_UNAVAILABLE when the guest lane is missing, unreachable, silent or answers 502/504 — never a status Cloudflare swaps for its own text/plain 502

oracle.ref: PR #1181 (fix); fix evidence: #811 F-S5-001; 11/10/2026 curl https://cowork.tracy.site/design-inspiration/api/brand/example.com → 502 text/plain 'error code: 502' from Cloudflare, while the origin on the dev machine answered 502 application/json LANE_UNAVAILABLE (GUEST_SITE_KEY unset there).
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0'. With no guestSiteKey, a throwing lane fetch, a throwing guest-session mint, a lane 502/504 and a lane that never answers, GET /design-inspiration/api/brand/<host> answers 503 application/json {code: 'LANE_UNAVAILABLE'} with the translated message; a lane's own JSON 404 still passes through. A guest-session mint that never answers is cut off within laneTimeoutMs and answered 503 LANE_UNAVAILABLE (before review fix L2 it hung for good), and a lane answer whose body streams on past laneTimeoutMs is delivered whole (before: the timeout signal errored the body halfway).
